notes.title: Update on the Development and Progress of Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, I want to thank each of you for your patience and support over the past few months. I know it has been a considerable wait, and I want to provide a full explanation along with an announcement of what's coming in the upcoming 1.1 update.
[h1]
Aligning the Public Release with the Beta[/h1]

Currently, the beta version of the game has advanced further than the official public release, with new features and improvements that haven't yet made it to the main version. At this time, there will no longer be a beta version. My priority now is to synchronize the public version with the beta, so that everyone has access to the latest updates and features. Steam will release this update in the coming hours.

[h1]Future 1.1 Update: 300 New Puzzle Levels![/h1]

I'm excited to share that in version 1.1 of the game, which will be released in the near future, there will be 300 new levels distributed across the four current game modes: Classic, Color, Block Classic, and Color Classic. I hope you enjoy these new challenges as much as I enjoyed creating them! These levels will keep the essence of each mode and test your skills in fresh and exciting ways.

[h1]New Game Modes in Development[/h1]

I know many of you are also looking forward to the new game modes I previously mentioned. Unfortunately, these have proven to be a bigger challenge than expected, so the new modes and their specific puzzles will be released in a future update. I'm working hard to ensure that, when they arrive, these new modes will be as polished and fun as the current ones.

[h1]Technical Issues and Apologies[/h1]

Unfortunately, I’ve been facing unforeseen issues that have severely impacted the game’s development. As I mentioned in a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2240720/announcements/detail/4194619900943494221]previous update[/url], I’ve been dealing with power supply problems that lasted much longer than expected, completely preventing me from working on the game.

These issues forced me to relocate, which further complicated the situation. The process of finding a new place, moving, and settling in took longer than expected, which resulted in a delay of over a month in development.

I understand that this situation is far from ideal, and I feel deeply embarrassed for causing this significant delay. I sincerely apologize, as this was completely out of my control, but I understand how it has affected the game's progress and communication with you, the community. Now that I’m fully settled in, I’m committed to resuming development at the proper pace.

Thank you again for your understanding and continued support. I look forward to hearing your feedback on the new levels and continuing to improve the game for all of you.

See you soon with more updates!

notes.title: NONOTOWN Update Available!
notes.notes:
Hello, NONOTOWN players!

I am excited to announce a new update for NONOTOWN and share the latest features and improvements with you. This update includes several enhancements and fixes based on your feedback and suggestions.
Update Highlights:

[b]   New Zoom System for Large Nonograms:[/b]

        You can now zoom in on large nonograms for a more comfortable gameplay experience.
        This includes a tool to count the elements of the current line as well as the hidden elements.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574240/d1ba4a15bb5fe26dec6e1a699750cbe6f111562d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574240/bb0dd898c3667b2f8f878f32a9a5eb23cec568f2.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574240/9037f07f165223bca5f827aaee449b4b5d172741.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574240/69d0c0e35fbb19fab1751dcdbacfc513e9074f0d.png[/img][/url]

[b]     Added Sounds:[/b]

        I have added the missing sounds to enhance the auditory experience of the game.

[b]    Minor Bug Fixes in Blocks:[/b]
        Several minor bugs affecting blocks in the game have been fixed.

[b]    New Test Levels:[/b]
        A few test levels of size 40x40 have been added so you can test the new zoom system.

[b]    Nonogram Validator:[/b]
        I am working on a validator for both classic and color nonograms.
[b]
    Other Minor Fixes:[/b]
        Other minor bugs have been fixed to improve game stability.

I want to thank you for your continuous support and patience. I apologize for the delay in releasing this update. As mentioned in the Steam discussion forum, there were unforeseen circumstances that delayed development.

[h2]
ROADMAP[/h2]

This will be the[b] last beta update[/b] before I release the full game in the coming days.

[b]Future Updates:[/b]

    After the new release, I plan to add a significant number of new levels for the 4 current game modes.
    I will also add 4 more game modes (2 Classic and 2 Color) with their respective levels.

Once again, I want to thank all of you for your constant support. I couldn't have come this far without you!

I hope you enjoy the update and look forward to your feedback and suggestions!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update on the Development of NONOTOWN
notes.notes:
Dear NONOTOWN players, 

I want to take a moment to share an important update about the development of the game and the recent challenges we've been facing.

Over the past few weeks, we have been dealing with an unprecedented heatwave in our area. This situation has caused excessive electrical demand, leading to blackouts and power surges that have severely affected my work equipment. Due to these issues, I have been working closely with an electrician to find a solution and have had to replace several damaged components. Fortunately, none of the hard drives have been affected so far, but these setbacks have prevented me from working for the past two weeks.

Just before these problems began, I was about to release an update that included a zoom feature for larger nonograms, along with some test nonograms for you to try out the new functionality. However, due to the mentioned interruptions, I have not been able to complete this update.

I deeply regret the delay and the lack of communication. It has been a frustrating experience dealing with these adversities, but I want you to know that I am doing everything possible to resolve these issues as soon as possible and continue with the game's updates.

I appreciate your patience and understanding during this difficult time. I hope to share more positive news soon and resume the normal development of NONOTOWN.

Thank you for your continued support!

Best regards,

notes.title: NONOTOWN Beta Update: Version 1.0.141 Enhancements and Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hello, all NONOTOWN players!

I'm thrilled to announce version 1.0.141, a significant update bringing key fixes and new features to enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for your ongoing support and for sharing your feedback with me!

What's new in version 1.0.141:

    [b]Fixes to switches in the Settings menu[/b]: I've addressed issues with switches in the settings menu for smoother navigation.

    [b]Fix for gamepad vibration error[/b]: Gamepad vibration now works seamlessly for a more immersive gaming experience.

    [b]Color selection via the numeric keypad[/b]: You can now easily select colors on Color boards using the numeric keys corresponding to the number of colors available.

    [b]Configurable Highlight mode[/b]: Customize your gaming experience with a new Highlight mode that you can set to appear always, never, or only on large boards.

    [b]Bug fixes and performance improvements[/b]: I've fixed issues like gamepad movement errors, cell counter correction, and other minor improvements for a smoother, interruption-free gaming experience.

Plans for future updates:

    [b]Improvements to color schemes[/b]: I'm working on enhancing color schemes to make Color boards more visually appealing and easier to solve.

    [b]Zoom system for larger nonograms[/b]: I'm developing a zoom system so you can enjoy larger nonograms with greater comfort and precision.

I deeply appreciate all players for their feedback and for continuing to play NONOTOWN. Your suggestions and comments are crucial in making this game even better!

Download the latest update and dive into the fun of solving nonograms in NONOTOWN!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: NONOTOWN Version 1.0.139 Now Available in Beta Branch!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Nonogram enthusiasts! I am thrilled to announce the latest update for NONOTOWN, now live in the Beta branch with version 1.0.139. This update brings a range of exciting improvements and fixes to enhance your nonogram-solving experience. Let's dive into what's new:

[list]
[*]     New Hint System for Color Nonograms: I've introduced a brand-new hint system specifically designed for color nonograms, making your solving journey more intuitive and enjoyable.

[*]     Block Locking Feature: In "Blocks" and "Color Blocks" game types, you can now "Lock" a block by marking it, indicating that it's correctly placed. This feature helps me keep track of blocks in their correct positions.

[*]     Visual Bug Fixes: I've addressed visual bugs in blocks and font sizes within nonogram hints, ensuring a smoother and clearer interface.

[*]     Color Enhancements: Certain colors in color puzzles have been adjusted to improve contrast and readability, making puzzles easier to decipher.

[*]     Improved "?" Marks: Now, "?" marks can be overwritten in "Toggle" input mode, providing me with more flexibility during gameplay.

[*]     Refreshed Block Puzzles: I've revamped block puzzles in the Sports and School categories under the "Blocks" game type.

[*]     Double Click Bug Fix: I fixed a bug related to double-clicking blocks, ensuring the second rotation functions correctly.

[*]     UI Enhancements: I've resolved an issue preventing the last played category from loading correctly, allowing for seamless puzzle selection within that category.

[*]     Miscellaneous Bug Fixes: I also squashed several minor bugs to improve overall game stability.
[/list]

I have a couple of additional features in the pipeline before I update the game to the master version, ensuring all players can enjoy these enhancements soon. I appreciate your patience as I work on these final touches.

Thank you for your continued support and understanding while waiting for this update. I hope you thoroughly enjoy the improvements, and I apologize for any inconvenience caused by the delay in releasing this update. Happy puzzling!

notes.title: 🎉 Exciting Update Alert! NONOTOWN 1.0.125.7 is Now Live. 🎮
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Nonogram enthusiasts! I am thrilled to announce the latest update for NONOTOWN, version 1.0.125.7! 🚀

What's New:

    [b]Introducing a New Painting Mode! 🎨[/b]
        Now, I invite you to enjoy a fresh way to fill cells/blocks on the grid. With the new placement/painting mode, cells are no longer overwritten; instead, they are swapped with the chosen option. You can toggle between this innovative input method and the original overwrite mode.

    [b]Bug Fixes 🐞[/b]
        I've addressed some minor bugs to enhance your gaming experience. 

What Does the New Painting Mode Bring to the Table?

The addition of this feature offers a unique twist to the gameplay. You can now choose between the classic overwrite mode and the new painting mode, allowing for a more customized and flexible nonogram-solving experience. Experiment with both options and discover the one that suits your style!


[b]What's Next? 🚀[/b]

But that's not all! I am already hard at work developing a brand-new algorithm for hint revelation. Stay tuned for upcoming updates that promise to elevate your nonogram-solving skills to a whole new level.

notes.title: Exciting Update for NONOTOWN - Version 1.0.124!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Nonogram enthusiasts![/h1]

I am thrilled to announce the latest update to NONOTOWN, bringing the game to version 1.0.124! Your feedback has been invaluable, and I'm excited to share the improvements we've made based on your suggestions.

What's New:

[list]
[*]     Disable Autofill Option: Your feedback matters, and I've listened! In response to your suggestions, I've added an option to disable the autofill of lines with [X] when completing clues. Now you have more control over how you want to approach each puzzle.


[*] New Hint Algorithm: I've introduced an additional hint-solving algorithm, enhancing the puzzle-solving experience. The best part? You get to choose which algorithm to use! This feature is available for both Classic and Blocks game types. Importantly, the modes/game types "Color" and "Block Color" remain unaffected by these changes.
[/list]

[b]Looking Ahead:[/b]

I'm not stopping here! I am committed to continuously enhancing the gameplay experience and, excitingly, I'll be releasing the Linux version in the near future. Stay tuned for more updates!

[b]Acknowledgments:[/b]

I want to express my sincere gratitude to all the players who have provided feedback. Your input has been incredibly valuable, and it motivates me to create a game that truly resonates with you.

notes.title: 🌟 Exciting Game Update! Version 1.0.121 is Here! 🌟
notes.notes:
Hello Nonogram Enthusiasts!

I am thrilled to announce the latest update for our nonogram game, and I can't wait for you to dive into the new features and improvements. Here are the highlights:

[b]1. Cell Counter Option - Now Available![/b]

In response to your valuable feedback, I've just rolled out version 1.0.121, featuring the highly-anticipated "Cell Counter" option. This functionality, as outlined in my roadmap, allows you to keep track of the selected cells while solving puzzles. By default, it's turned off to preserve the classic experience, but enthusiasts can easily activate it through the settings menu. Enjoy the added flexibility in your gameplay!

[b]2. Bug Squashing: "First Puzzle" Achievement Unlock![/b]

I'm dedicated to providing a seamless gaming experience, and that's why I've addressed a pesky bug that was affecting the unlocking of the "First Puzzle" achievement. Now, you can fully enjoy the satisfaction of conquering that initial challenge without any hiccups.

I appreciate the incredible support from our player community. Your passion for nonograms drives me to keep enhancing the game. Thank you for choosing my game, and I hope these updates add even more joy to your nonogram-solving adventures!

[b]🚀 What's Next?[/b]

I'm not stopping here! I'm already hard at work on the next set of features and improvements outlined in my roadmap. Stay tuned for more exciting updates in the near future.

Thank you for being part of our nonogram community, and happy puzzling!

notes.title: Important Update for NONOTOWN Players!
notes.notes:
Hello, dedicated NONOTOWN enthusiasts! 👋

I come bearing good news and a sincere apology. Recently, some of you encountered difficulties completing levels in the "Blocks" game type. I am genuinely sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused.

I am pleased to announce that we have successfully recovered the corrupted levels in the latest update, version 1.0.117 for "Blocks." Now you can resume your puzzle-solving journey without any hindrance.

In addition to fixing the corrupted levels, I've identified and addressed a minor issue. Some users reported a glitch when displaying hints while loading saved data in both "Blocks" and "Blocks Colors." I'm thrilled to inform you that this problem has been rectified in the latest version, 1.0.119.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the vigilant users who promptly reported these issues. Your dedication to enhancing the gaming experience is truly commendable.

I understand the frustration such hiccups can cause, and I want to assure you that your feedback is invaluable. I am genuinely sorry for any inconvenience caused, and I appreciate your patience.

Moving forward, I am eager to let you know that I'll be actively working on incorporating user-suggested improvements. Your ideas and insights are crucial to making NONOTOWN the best it can be.

Thank you for being an essential part of our gaming community. Keep those feedback gems coming, and let's make NONOTOWN even more fantastic together!

Happy playing!

notes.title: DEMO Update: New hint reveal algorithm
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to announce that I've just released an update to NONOTOWN! I've been working hard to address some of the feedback I've received from players, and the biggest change in this update is the improvement to my hint-revealing algorithm.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2240720/extras/new_hint_system.gif[/img]

Several players had mentioned that they found the previous algorithm to be a bit confusing or inconsistent, so I've updated it to make the hints clearer and easier to follow. I hope this makes the game more enjoyable for everyone, and I'm always looking for ways to improve, so please keep letting me know what you think.

If you've played the game before, I'd love to hear your thoughts on the new update. Did you notice a difference in the way the hints are presented? Is the game more fun or challenging now? Please share your feedback in the comments section below!

And finally, I want to say a big thank you to all the players who took the time to write to me and share their thoughts on the game. I really appreciate your feedback and it helps me make the game better for everyone. Thank you!

notes.title: DEMO Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I'm excited to announce the latest update to my game demo! I've been working hard to bring you some great new features and improvements to make your gaming experience even better.

One of the biggest changes in this update is the new theme selector. I know that everyone has different preferences when it comes to the look and feel of their game, so I've added the ability for you to choose from a variety of themes to customize your gaming experience.

In addition to the new theme selector, I've also made some improvements to the game's translations. I've gone through and corrected some errors and made some tweaks to make sure that the game is as clear and understandable as possible, no matter what language you're playing in.

I've also made some adjustments to the puzzle completion screen. I know that completing a puzzle can be a satisfying experience, and I wanted to make sure that the screen you see when you finish a puzzle reflects that. With these changes, you'll get a better sense of accomplishment when you finish a puzzle.

Of course, I know that no update is perfect, and there were some bugs that needed to be fixed. I've addressed a number of minor bugs to improve the overall stability of the game demo.

That being said, I want to acknowledge that I still have work to do. I know that the ability to undo and redo moves is an important feature, and I'm actively working on adding that to the game demo. I appreciate your patience as I work to bring this feature to you.

I hope you enjoy the latest update to my game demo, and as always, if you have any feedback or suggestions for future updates, please let me know. Happy gaming!
